title: Mean of one correlated pair summand
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, let $a=(a_i)_{i=1}^n$ be real coefficients, and choose a coordinate $i$. Under the correlated sign-pair distribution obtained by drawing a uniform sign vector and independently keeping each coordinate with probability $(1+\rho)/2$ or flipping it otherwise, the expected vector $(a_i x_i,a_i y_i)\in\mathbb R^2$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: real coefficient function on Fin n
